label: LTX SDR to HDR
description: LTX-2.5 IC-LoRA SDR to HDR. Output: scene-linear HDR at plate resolution and frame numbers, no upper clip.
usage: Turns an SDR plate into scene-linear HDR for a frame range (LTX-2.5).
Whole input range is sent; tick 'input range' to send only first-last.
'exposure' shifts the decoded HDR in stops; lower 'work scale' if it is slow or runs out of memory.
Press Render in ComfyUI; Bring in output reads the result under the node.

License (checked 2026-11): LTX-2.x Community - commercial use is free under $10M annual revenue (affiliates count); above that needs a paid license. Generated content must be disclosed as machine-generated when distributed.

max_frames_input.tooltip: LTX-2.5 SDR to HDR runs up to 241 frames here; longer ranges need more VRAM.
